high_level_description: This image depicts the Statue of Liberty at night, illuminated against a dark sky with some clouds. The statue is prominently featured, standing tall on its pedestal. The torch held high in one hand and the tablet or book in the other hand are clearly visible, symbolizing enlightenment and freedom. The pedestal of the statue is lit from within, casting a warm glow that contrasts with the cool blue tones of the night sky. The surrounding area appears to be dimly lit, emphasizing the statue as the focal point.
